title: Sherlock Holmes: A Study in Scarlet — Ep 11/14 — "A Flight for Life"
description:
A Study in Scarlet, Episode 11. The morning after the Prophet's visit, John Ferrier rides into the city with a letter for Nevada -- and comes home to two strange horses hitched to his own gate.

The sons of Elders Stangerson and Drebber are in his sitting-room with their boots on the stove, come for his daughter's hand. He shows them the door, and the window. Next morning there is a paper pinned to his coverlet: twenty-nine days are given you for amendment, and then -- a dash. The count comes down day by day, on the ceiling, on the door, on the gate.

On the night the figure two goes up, a scratching at the door; Ferrier throws it open on nothing, and looks down at a man lying flat on his face across the threshold. Jefferson Hope has come the last mile on his belly. The house is watched on every side. Tomorrow is the last day.

Through the side window, along the hedge, past the sentries' countersign, and up into the Eagle Canyon by moonlight -- where a solitary watcher on a rock calls down: who goes there?

Chapter IV of Part Two of Arthur Conan Doyle's A Study in Scarlet (1887), in the public domain.

— The Keeper's Lantern —
Every episode is one whole chapter, in order, from the first page to the last.
